title: Node
description: Schema for node.yaml — the structured description of a single context node (project, component, or deliverable) in InfoTP Context Studio. A node is a folder (D2) identified by the proposal's own code (D1); dependency edges are ID references, never file paths.

id.description: Node identifier. Uses the proposal's own codes (D1): C1-C7 optionally with a sub-letter/number (e.g. C4A2), INF# for infrastructure nodes, or the literal 'project' for the project-layer node.

component.description: The parent component code (e.g. "C4"). Omitted for the project node.

type.description: The kind of artifact this node results in.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the node.

owner.description: Role IDs (e.g. RH5) responsible for this node.

kind.description: Tags selecting which directives apply to this node (D3): a node only inherits directives whose applies_to intersects this list.

depends_on.description: IDs of nodes this node depends on. Always ID references, never file paths (D1).

directives.description: Inline node-level directives, in addition to those in this node's directives.yaml.

corpus.description: Filenames present in this node's corpus/ directory, used by the RAG interface (D10).

hito.description: Project milestone this node is due at (Hitos A-F from the proposal cronograma). Omitted for the project node.

due_month.description: Month (1-16) by which this node's result is due, per the proposal's delivery table.
